source.title: Armagh Guardian, 20 May 1955, p. 5 ("Not a Single Contest: County and Rural Councillors Unopposed") ("Co. Council")
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names from the OCR text of the page (clean apart from the noted spellings; not compared line by line with the image); returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1955: nominations received by H. W. F. Reid, returning officer; not more than one candidate for each seat, so there was no poll. No party labels printed, so none are given. Returned unopposed. Isaac G. Hawthorne: no party label printed in 1955. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Central Armagh, Parliament of Northern Ireland, 15 October 1955, listed as Unionist; Central Armagh, Parliament of Northern Ireland, 20 March 1958, listed as Unionist).
